header.title: MCP Server
header.description: Let your team use their own AI apps — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor — with your institute's Vacademy data. Each person signs in with their own Vacademy account, so they only ever see what they can already see in Vacademy.

enable.title: Enable the MCP server
enable.description: Nothing is reachable until you turn this on.
enable.label: MCP server enabled
enable.hint: Off by default. Once it's on, your connection details appear below and your team can connect their AI apps.

connect.title: Connect your AI app
connect.description: Share these with the people you allow below. They'll be asked to sign in to Vacademy and approve the connection.
connect.clientIdHint: Created automatically for your institute and can't be removed. Only needed by apps that ask for a client ID.
connect.howToClaude: Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, then paste the server URL.
connect.howToCursor: Claude Code / Cursor: run claude mcp add --transport http vacademy <server URL>.
connect.howToManual: If an app asks for a client ID, paste your client ID above.

clients.title: Client IDs for other apps
clients.redirectHint: Comma-separated. Must be https, or http on localhost. The app's own documentation tells you what to use.
clients.createFailed: Could not create the client ID
clients.removeFailed: Could not remove the client ID
clients.addCustom: Add a client ID for another app

tools.title: What AI apps can do
tools.description: Choose, area by area, whether AI apps can only view or also make changes. Open a row to see exactly what it allows.
tools.empty: No tools are available on this server yet.
tools.eachOnItsOwn: Switch each of these on separately.
tools.summaryLine: {{on}} of {{total}} areas on · {{editing}} can make changes

roles.title: Who can connect
roles.description: Only these roles can connect an AI app. Everyone else is refused, even with a link.
roles.learnerNote: Learners and parents can never connect, whatever is selected here.
roles.empty: No roles can connect yet. Add one below — Admins are allowed by default.

perRole.title: Per-role access (advanced)
perRole.description: Grant extra capabilities to specific roles, on top of the set above. Leave a role uncustomized to use the settings above.

connections.title: Active connections
connections.description: AI apps currently connected to your institute. Revoking one takes effect immediately.

errors.infoUnavailable: Couldn't load the MCP server details. The server may not be enabled on this deployment yet, or ai-service may be unavailable. Tool options stay hidden until it loads — your saved settings are unaffected.
